6.title: まとめ：にている　かな

kana.intro: Hiragana and katakana that look alike, small and big kana, and sounds that are easy to mix up.

cards.note: Hiragana へ and katakana ヘ are the same shape. The other kana round them tell you which it is: へや (room) is all hiragana, ヘア (hair) all katakana.
Hiragana り's first stroke has a little hook at the bottom; katakana リ's strokes are plain lines.
か has a short stroke on the right; カ does not.
A big ツ is the sound tsu: スーツ, a suit. A small ッ is a short stop: サッカー, football.
A big ヨ is the sound yo: ヨーヨー. A small ョ joins the kana before it: チョコレート, cho-ko-rē-to.
チ is chi; ティ is ti: チーター, a cheetah; パーティー, a party.
